description: DeepSight eyes regression manifest. Golden = user-validated ground truth; synthetic = deterministic; public = Wikimedia Commons, title-anchored (see eval/images/public/.sources.json). Expected fields are anchored to current eyes behavior so regressions fail loudly; known weaknesses are documented in 'note'. 'gap': true entries that fail are accepted known gaps (⚠️, non-blocking); passing a gap is a gap-closed event (🎉). 'loop' blocks hold tier-1 reasoning-loop expectations: required = tokens the final description must contain, forbidden = tokens it must not (scored blind, the model never sees this file).

images.note: 1980 Philadelphia four-sport group photo (Erving/McGraw/Jaworski/Peeters). OCR reads SIXERS jersey; sports signals from grid-upscaled crops. Tier-1 note: eyes OCR also reads the fragment 'OUISVILLE' (a shirt); the loop must report it as jersey text and NOT claim the group are Louisville fans (old bug: 'Sixers fans in Louisville').
SGA mid-action on hardwood, OKC Thunder jersey. Upscaled OCR reads THUNDE. scene_top1 varies between runs (basketball vs ballgames) — expect the stable ballgames label top-3.

UNISTELLAR smart-telescope brand photo. KNOWN WEAKNESS: hat -> baseball false positive (0.80) is anchored on purpose; fixing it is a future change that must update this entry. Loop required baseball documents propagation of that anchored signal.
Blue-toned abstract/jellyfish art. Weak scene confidences (0.08) are the honest ceiling; assert the signals that are real.
Flat red canvas: no text, no people, no sports.
Flat blue canvas: no text, no people.
Red card with bold white STOP: OCR must read it.
White card with black DeepSight + SALE 50% OFF lines.
Single black rectangle on white: rectangle detector must fire.

Commons 'Pitcher (PSF).png' — public-domain line drawing of a pitcher. Tier-1 loop anchor retained: blind model must still name baseball from the drawing (suppressed it once: 'no athletics shown, just an illustration') — tracked so a prompt/eyes change that recovers it is measurable.
